description:
Brand Introduction

Discovvy is a dynamic e-commerce platform specializing in high-quality gadgets and home decor. We combine practicality and style, offering products that elevate your everyday living. From innovative diffusers to cutting-edge tech gadgets, Discovvy curates a selection designed to enhance comfort, convenience, and aesthetics.

Product Description

Our product range includes:

  • High-Quality Gadgets: Portable coffee makers, magnetic chargers, smart devices, and more—designed to make life easier and more efficient.
  • Home Décor and Diffusers: Elegant, functional pieces like ultrasonic aromatherapy diffusers, decorative lights, and organizers to transform spaces into serene, organized environments.
    Every item at Discovvy is meticulously chosen for quality, usability, and design to meet our customers' needs.

USP (Unique Selling Point)

  • Premium Quality: Products built for durability and function with stylish designs.
  • Affordable Innovation: Top-notch technology and home decor at competitive prices.
  • Customer-Centric: Exceptional customer service and fast, secure shipping.
  • Eco-Friendly Options: Products that focus on sustainability and reducing waste.

Payment Terms

  • Commission Rates: Affiliates earn 10%-15% commission per sale, depending on product categories.
  • Payment Frequency: Payouts are processed monthly, with a minimum threshold of $50.
  • Payment Methods: Choose between PayPal or bank transfer

Other Information

  • Affiliate Tools: Affiliates get access to banners, product links, and real-time analytics to track performance.
  • Exclusive Discounts: Affiliates can offer their audience special discount codes, boosting conversion rates.
  • Global Reach: Discovvy ships worldwide, giving affiliates access to international markets.
  • Support Team: Dedicated affiliate support for queries and assistance with marketing strategies.
